The base binds 32 genuine retained producer files, both executables and six
receipts. Its three-entry capture set has 32 commits, six schemas, a genuine
view through history, and exact single-leaf and multi-leaf descriptions. The
producer reports 79,209,683 bytes of old full-image equivalent; the actual
native stream is 22,561,312 bytes. The overlay pins the independent caller
sources, source scope and explicit public policies. The original manifest's
available-unverified history marker and inventory's unavailable history marker
describe different domains. Nonlocal declarations and view definitions stay
inert evidence.

The test checks both compressed hashes, extracts regular files into an owned
output directory and rehashes the complete combined census. It invokes the
pinned Python harness with the combined manifest hash and size. That harness
independently replays the source, launches the retained receiver's actual
prepare-request and default memory/SQLite receive routes, and freezes original
argv, waits and output before parsing. The inspector opens a byte-exact copy
of the retained SQLite target through the ordinary driver, verifies recovery,
all revision mappings, present and absent historical/current tables, family
counts and every original capture blob, and preserves the original target.
Driver Open can write setup on the copy; subsequent calls use recovery/read
APIs. No views, triggers or aliases are activated.

Source integration is AUTHORED_NOT_RUN until an exact remote original exists.
An execution result applies only to this retained pair. Full accounting
category preimages and repeated lifecycle multiplicities, independent business
mapping semantics, reverse/undo execution, both 1200-commit loose and archived
public cases and the final public procedure remain separate. Every generated
result keeps publication_authorized=false and private=HARD_DISABLED.
